protocol.name: Example USDC Vault
protocol.summary: An ERC-4626 USDC vault on Arc, described as a Lykia adapter. The addresses point at the Morpho Galaxy USDC vault so the example validates on Arc mainnet.

abi: function deposit(uint256 assets, address receiver) returns (uint256 shares)
function withdraw(uint256 assets, address receiver, address owner) returns (uint256 shares)

preconditions: The deposit fits under the vault's cap.

failures.meaning: The account holds less USDC than the deposit.
The vault refused the deposit (cap reached or paused).

preconditions: The account holds shares worth at least the amount.
The vault has idle liquidity for it.

failures.meaning: Not enough shares, or not enough idle liquidity in the vault.

reads.purpose: USDC the account can withdraw now.
USDC (6 decimals) for one share (18 decimals).

risk.oracle: none for deposits; the curator's markets use their own oracles
notes: Example manifest: replace every field with your protocol's own facts.

evidence: EIP-4626 standard; vault address from the Lykia registry (eth_getCode on Arc mainnet, 2026-11-01).
